title: Lab 1 - Birinchi pipeline’ingiz
description: Loyiha yarating, uch job’li pipeline yozing, uni buzing, log’larni o’qing.
scenario: Yo’nalish uchun qoralama loyihani sozlang va birinchi pipeline’ingizni ishga tushiring. Bitta job’ni ataylab buzing va job log’ini har qatorini tushuntira olguningizcha o’qing.
